title.en: Side-scrolling shooter: boss fights (on foot and by plane)

view.en: Side-view 2D. You control a reel gunner, on foot or in a small plane for the flying scenes; your health and cards are shown at the bottom of the screen, and the boss's state is shown on screen; read the health bar yourself.

goal.en: Empty the boss's health bar in its last phase to win (the screen shows 'A KNOCKOUT!'). You have 3 health points and lose when they run out; a timeout is not a win. Health does not regenerate.

mouse.en: The mouse does not aim in this game; left and right click only duplicate fire and EX.

keys.en: ground: aim up; plane: fly up
ground: crouch / aim down (crouched shots go straight ahead); plane: fly down
ground: jump, press again in the air to parry pink objects (bounce and gain 1 card); plane: parry pink objects any time
ground: dash (no invulnerability); plane: hold to shrink, smaller and faster but only short weak shots, no EX or super
hold to fire rapidly (plane default: auto gun)
EX move for 1 card; with 5 cards the super: a sweep ray on the ground, blast form in the plane
ground: hold to stand still and aim in 8 directions (cannot run)
plane: swap auto gun and drop bombs (higher damage, slower, arcing fall)
release the super at 5 cards (same as K)

notes.en: Four scenes are ground fights (seed bloom, bouncing blob, boxing frogs, garden trio) and two are plane fights (zodiac shifter, chick). Key meanings differ by scene; you play the reel gunner, on foot or in a plane.
Ground: W/S combined with A/D aims in 8 directions; crouching with S shoots straight ahead; holding L locks you in place, standing, unable to run.
Plane: W/A/S/D fly in 8 directions and L does nothing; Q swaps auto gun and drop bombs; holding Shift shrinks you, with no EX or super.
Pink objects can be parried: on the ground press jump (Space) again in the air, in the plane press Space any time; each parry gives 1 card, each card powers one EX, and 5 cards give the super.
Super: on the ground a horizontal sweep ray; in the plane a blast form that explodes on contact or timeout, followed by about 3 seconds of invulnerability.
Dash gives no invulnerability, so do not dash through attacks. You are briefly invulnerable after being hit.
In the action options, a sub-step is one of six slices of a 200 ms packet; jump, parry and dash only count on a new press, which is why options differ in press timing.

move.en: Movement and aiming; every option except none also holds shoot. On the ground W/S aim up/down and S crouches; in the plane W/S fly.

options.right_short: move/aim right for the first 2 sub-steps only, shooting
options.up_right_short: move/aim up-right for the first 2 sub-steps only, shooting
options.up_short: move/aim up for the first 2 sub-steps only, shooting
options.up_left_short: move/aim up-left for the first 2 sub-steps only, shooting
options.left_short: move/aim left for the first 2 sub-steps only, shooting
options.down_left_short: move/aim down-left for the first 2 sub-steps only, shooting
options.down_short: move/aim down for the first 2 sub-steps only, shooting
options.down_right_short: move/aim down-right for the first 2 sub-steps only, shooting
options.left_turn_1: run left 1 sub-step(s) then turn to face right, shooting
options.right_turn_1: run right 1 sub-step(s) then turn to face left, shooting
options.left_turn_2: run left 2 sub-step(s) then turn to face right, shooting
options.right_turn_2: run right 2 sub-step(s) then turn to face left, shooting
options.left_turn_3: run left 3 sub-step(s) then turn to face right, shooting
options.right_turn_3: run right 3 sub-step(s) then turn to face left, shooting
options.left_turn_4: run left 4 sub-step(s) then turn to face right, shooting
options.right_turn_4: run right 4 sub-step(s) then turn to face left, shooting
options.left_turn_5: run left 5 sub-step(s) then turn to face right, shooting
options.right_turn_5: run right 5 sub-step(s) then turn to face left, shooting

act.en: Jump / parry / EX / dash / aim-lock / weapon swap, one key action per sub-step.

options.jump_tap: jump (plane: parry), press in sub-step 1 only
options.jump_hold_parry: jump held 2 sub-steps, then hold for an air parry from sub-step 4
options.jump_parry: jump, then air parry at sub-step 4
options.press_3: press jump at sub-step 3 (air parry timing)
options.press_4: press jump at sub-step 4 (air parry timing)
options.press_5: press jump at sub-step 5 (air parry timing)
options.lock_jump_parry: hold aim-lock, jump, parry at sub-step 4
options.lock_late: aim-lock for the last two sub-steps
options.ex: EX shot (1 card; super at 5 cards)
options.jump_dash: jump, then air dash at sub-step 4
options.jump3_dash6: jump at sub-step 3, air dash at sub-step 6
options.swap: plane: swap machine gun / drop bombs

summary.en: Ground fight in a forest clearing: a blue blob bounces around, grows to throw punches, and finally drops tombstones.

tell.en: It squashes down before each leap; small and big forms jump to different heights.

counter.en: Track the landing spot and shoot it in the air; it rebounds off side walls.

tell.en: It faces you and winds up; the giant form blinks before its first punch.

effect.en: The fist deals 1 damage on hit.

counter.en: Crouch under the punch; dash has no invulnerability.

tell.en: It swallows a candy and three pink question marks appear.

counter.en: Press jump again in the air to parry the pink marks; this is the only parry in this fight.

tell.en: A tombstone slides back and forth in the background, then pauses.

effect.en: Its slam deals 1 damage; the slide itself is harmless.

counter.en: Leave the spot it has locked on to.

phases.en: Small form first, then big form, and tombstones join in the last phase.

summary.en: Ground fight against three vegetables in turn: potato, onion, carrot; not attacking the onion for about six seconds leads to the hidden-radish branch.

tell.en: The potato spits several dirt balls, the last one a pink worm.

counter.en: Jump over the balls; parry the pink worm in mid-air.

tell.en: The onion cries once hit; pink tears are mixed into the rain.

counter.en: Watch the drop points above; about six seconds without attacking enters the hidden-radish branch.

tell.en: The big carrot in the background summons homing mini carrots.

effect.en: Mini carrots deal 1 damage on contact; the big background body is harmless.

counter.en: Shoot the mini carrots down; they take only a few hits.

tell.en: The third eye charges up, then fires rings aimed at you.

counter.en: Keep repositioning; three shots in regular mode, two in simple and expert.

phases.en: Potato, onion and carrot appear in order; a hidden-radish branch may follow.

summary.en: Plane fight in the sky: the boss turns into a bull, twins and an archer in turn, ending with a moon phase.

tell.en: In normal form it laughs and fires HA letters, then small planes enter.

counter.en: Parry every fourth pink shot from purple planes; green fans cannot be parried.

tell.en: The bull lines up with your height, pauses, then thrusts its horns.

counter.en: Dodge up or down once its height locks.

tell.en: The twins summon rotating lines of bullets on your side.

counter.en: Stay clear of the lines and never cross the centre.

tell.en: The archer charges an arrow, then three blue stars follow.

effect.en: The arrow or stars deal 1 damage.

counter.en: The arrow keeps a fixed direction, so leave early; the blue stars can be shot down.

tell.en: In the moon phase a UFO slides sideways, changes colour, charges, then fires.

counter.en: Red fires straight below you, gold fires ahead; shrink to slip through gaps.

phases.en: Normal form, bull, twins, archer, and finally the moon with the UFO.

summary.en: Ground fight in a garden with an upper and lower platform layer; in phase two the floor grows thorns and vines block paths.

tell.en: Its face and arms sweep along the upper platform or the lower floor.

counter.en: Jump up or leave the platform to switch layers.

tell.en: Magic hands launch boomerang sycamore seeds, or 3-4 acorns aimed at you.

counter.en: Switch layers against seeds; move before the acorns are thrown.

tell.en: The head becomes a gun spitting seeds: blue homes in, purple becomes a small plant on the floor, pink can be parried.

counter.en: Shoot homing seeds; parry pink seeds and pink shots from floating flowers.

tell.en: In phase two the floor grows thorns, dandelions drift by and vines intermittently block platforms.

effect.en: Thorns, dandelions and vines deal 1 damage.

counter.en: Stay on platforms; switch when a vine shows its growth warning.

phases.en: Phase two adds thorns, dandelions and vines.

summary.en: Ground fight: the left frog punches, the right frog spits fireflies, over three phases ending with a slot machine.

tell.en: The left frog throws low, mid and high punch waves, some pink, going back and forth in phase one.

counter.en: Jump or crouch under; pink punches can be parried.

tell.en: The right frog spits fireflies that slowly close in.

counter.en: One shot kills one.

tell.en: At the end of a phase the left frog rolls along the floor across the arena.

counter.en: Jump over it.

tell.en: In phase two the left frog slaps out three bouncing balls while the right frog turns and blows you toward it.

counter.en: Run or dash against the wind and pass through gaps between balls.

tell.en: In phase three it spits coins first; the lever turns pink before it can be hurt; tiger, snake and bull spiked chip platforms.

effect.en: Coins, spikes and fire deal 1 damage.

counter.en: Parry the lever; jump over, stand on or dodge fire depending on the chip.

phases.en: Three phases: fists and fireflies, wind and balls, slot machine.

summary.en: Plane fight against a birdhouse; phase two is the chick's egg shield and phase three is a stretcher.

tell.en: The birdhouse spits eggs that burst into fragments at the screen edge.

counter.en: Predict the fragment directions.

tell.en: The head becomes a three-fingered hand and, after a delay, fires three big shots in a fan.

counter.en: Move out of the fan centre during the wind-up.

tell.en: A whistle scream, then flapping that fires feathers in eight directions; it rests when tired.

counter.en: Slip through feather gaps; focus fire while it rests.

tell.en: In phase two spiked eggs orbit the chick, extend and retract and block bullets; electric shots are always pink.

effect.en: Spiked eggs and electric shots deal 1 damage.

counter.en: Shoot through gaps when eggs retract; parry the electric shots.

tell.en: In phase three the stretcher spits junk (pink boots can be parried), a heart rises, and the nurse bird's pills split and home in.

effect.en: Junk and pills deal 1 damage; only the heart can be hurt once it appears.

counter.en: Use bombs from above or up close; shoot the heart when it appears.

phases.en: Three phases: birdhouse, chick egg shield, stretcher.
